{{Top|leg}}
A '''directional transceiver''' was a handheld device that could receive signals from [[homing transponder]]s. It was a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with two screens; one screen displayed the direction of the homing transponder, while the other provided the distance to the target. Directional transceivers had a range of five hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].
